prompt: Escribe el copy para la primera pantalla del flujo de compra de cripto para un usuario nuevo en Bitso Argentina que nunca ha comprado cripto. Necesito: título de pantalla, cuerpo explicativo (1-2 oraciones), y CTA principal. Locale: Español Argentina (es_AR).

assertions.description: Uses vos conjugation (podés, tenés, hacés) — not tú (puedes, tienes) or usted
assertions.check: file contains 'podés' or 'tenés' or 'empezá' or similar vos form

assertions.description: Output includes all three requested elements: title, body, and CTA
assertions.check: file contains a title/título section AND a body/cuerpo section AND a CTA section
title field contains no more than 6 words

assertions.description: No forbidden terms: sin riesgo, garantizado, rendimiento garantizado, gana X%
assertions.check: file does NOT contain 'sin riesgo' or 'garantizado' or 'gana' followed by '%'

assertions.description: CTA uses infinitive form (Comprar, Empezar, Explorar) — not vos imperative (Comprá)
assertions.check: CTA is in infinitive form per es_AR locale rule

assertions.description: Tone is warm and Inspiring — motivates without pressure; no cold or purely functional tone
assertions.check: qualitative — output should feel welcoming and action-oriented, not bureaucratic
